# source: installed ulem.sty 2019-11-18 summary and command definitions.
# The package changes emphasis unless normalem is selected. The normalem load
# binds nothing the engine renders, so it moves no ink where it stands
# (inert:normalem); the shared decoration path implements its straight strike,
# and patterned and double rules remain explicit refusals.
pre inert:normalem \usepackage[normalem]{ulem}
body impl \uline{x}
body impl \sout{x}
body refuse:W0301 \uuline{x}
body refuse:W0301 \uwave{x}
body refuse:W0301 \xout{x}
body refuse:W0301 \dashuline{x}
body refuse:W0301 \dotuline{x}
body refuse:W0301 \markoverwith{x}
body refuse:W0301 \useunder{\uline}{\bfseries}{\textbf}
body refuse:W0301 \normalem
